decision.interpretation: Bold, larger font (size 12) line 'C.3. Changes from RFC 7230' introduces the following explanatory paragraphs about protocol changes. Operates as a genuine section heading at its location.
Prominent bold title 'Acknowledgements' (size 14.4) stands alone above introductory text referencing another appendix. Functions as a standard document section heading here.
Standalone bold title 'Index' (size 14.4) precedes alphabetical index entries. Serves as a genuine document heading marking the start of the index section.
